ali: Opened a small PR to expand Troubleshooting -> Rate limits: added quick 429 vs 504 notes, Retry-After parsing, and minimal JS/Python snippets for polite fallback and context trimming. Need a couple eyes on wording.

courtney: Looks good. Two quick asks: 1) call out header variants (Retry-After, x-retry-after, x-rate-limit-reset) 2) include a short migration note about `retry_policy` -> `backoff_strategy`.

samir: Adding a tiny JS AbortController example so folks can see client-side timeouts distinct from server 504s. Also adding a pseudo token-trim snippet that drops oldest tokens first.

ali: Draft JS snippet in the PR: ```js
// handle Retry-After then fallback
const ra = parseInt(res.headers['retry-after'] || res.headers['x-retry-after'] || '0', 10);
if (ra > 0) await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ra * 1000));
await client.generate({ model: 'redwood-medium', messages: ctx });
```

courtney: Add note: prefer dropping oldest messages (prefix) when trimming so recent user intent is preserved. Also mention streaming: 429 may return partial frames; 504 usually closes the stream.

docs-bot: PR 7713: CI passed :white_check_mark: (docs build + linkcheck)

ali: Pushed the fixes and migration snippet: `"backoff_strategy": { "type": "exponential", "base_ms": 300, "max_ms": 8000, "jitter": true }`. Merging once CI green.

samir: LGTM, thanks.

ali: Merged. I'll add a changelog blurb and an SDK migration note.
